ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a transition-state/cyclic-conformation schematic; at the upper left there is carbonyl O=C and it is connected to R, at the lower left there is HN and an imine-like C=N fragment and it is connected to R2, on the right chain there is an alkene bond and it bears R1, and at the lower right there is H; on the right, negatively charged OAc is also drawn separately. There are multiple curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, only transcribe the chemical connectivity. The variable substituents R, R1, R2 are represented by the dummy atom `*`. The main skeleton is written according to the connections of the imine, conjugated alkene, and carbonyl in the figure as `*C(=N)C/C(*)=C\C(*)=O`, in which the slash directions corresponding to the depicted alkene/carbonyl chain are preserved. The acetate counterion on the right is written separately as the fragment `CC(=O)[O-]`, and is separated from the main fragment with a dot. Therefore the SMILES is `*C(=N)C/C(*)=C\C(*)=O.CC(=O)[O-]`.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First, inspect the image and transcribe only the chemical connectivity, not the arrows. The structure shows a TS scaffold with an imine fragment on one side, a conjugated alkene/ carbonyl chain in the middle, and a separate acetate ion on the right. Replace the two unlabeled attachment positions in the scaffold with `*` as dummy atoms. Keep the carbonyl and alkene stereochemical slashes as drawn, yielding the main fragment `*C(=N)C/C(*)=C\C(*)=O`. Then append the acetate counterion as a separate fragment, `CC(=O)[O-]`, using a dot. Final SMILES: `*C(=N)C/C(*)=C\C(*)=O.CC(=O)[O-]`.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个过渡态/环状构象示意，左上有羰基 O=C 并连到 R，左下有 HN 与一个亚胺样 C=N 片段并连到 R2，右侧链上有烯键并带 R1，右下有 H；右侧还单独画出带负电荷的 OAc。图中有多条弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。
推理：忽略箭头后，只转录化学连接关系。R、R1、R2 这些可变取代基用 dummy atom `*` 表示。主骨架按图中 imine、共轭烯烃和羰基的连接写为 `*C(=N)C/C(*)=C\C(*)=O`，其中保留图示对应的烯键/羰基链方向斜杠。右侧的 acetate counterion 单独作为片段写成 `CC(=O)[O-]`，并用点号与主片段分隔。因此 SMILES 为 `*C(=N)C/C(*)=C\C(*)=O.CC(=O)[O-]`。
